newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 4.65 million barrels in the week ended Jan 10 to 289.46 million barrels from a revised 284.82 million barrels that was previously reported as 286.13 million the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 1.50 million barrels in the week to 225.66 million barrels.
Distillate stocks fell 1.29 million barrels to 125.45 million from 126.74 million the previous week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 419,000 barrels to 46.79 million barrels.
API said gasoline production fell 434,000 barrels in the week to 7.23 million bpd from 7.66 million.
Gasoline stocks rose 415,000 barrels in the week to 196.42 million barrels from 196.01 million barrels.
Percent of stocks capacity fell to 90.7 percent from 92.3 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 140,000 barrels to 38.82 million barrels from 38.68 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units fell to 13.77 million barrels from 14.08 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 43.63 million barrels from 43.37 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports rose to 7.65 million barrels per day from 6.02 million, API said.
